document_metadata.document_title: New Hampshire Model Stormwater Standards / NH Stormwater Manual (city regs)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: WQV = (P)(Rv)(A) where P = 1 inch of rainfall, Rv = 0.05 + 0.9(I), A = total site area draining to the structure (NH Model Stormwater Standards / NH Stormwater Manual). Manchester Sewer & Stormwater regulations implement NHDES post-construction standards consistent with this manual.
